headline: Risiko resumes | Intesa relaunches the OPAS on MPS
summary: Intesa has relaunched its OPAS offer on Monte dei Paschi di Siena. The bank's board told MPS shareholders to reject Lovaglio's plan at the shareholders' meeting on 29 October.
why: Intesa Sanpaolo is Italy's largest bank, and a takeover bid for Monte dei Paschi would reshape the Italian banking sector.
